verdict.rationale: Bolt.new's core interaction model is natural-language prompting that drives full-stack app generation, editing, deployment, and third-party integrations (npm installs, servers, deploys 'from chat'), confirmed by both docs and hands-on community reports of building apps via prompts. Community evidence also shows real friction (doom loops, context pollution, unauthorized destructive changes) indicating imperfect reliability of pure NL control. missing for 10: no formal benchmark/documentation of NL command coverage or reliability metrics, and independent evidence shows failures requiring manual code inspection/reverts rather than pure NL control.
